video_title: Boogie, Lou & Chandler Debate if Cooper Flagg is ELITE! Should Mavs TRADE Kyrie Irving?!

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Chandler Parsons ranks Cooper Flagg as a top 20 NBA player
quotes.excerpt: Right now, I would rank him top 20 in the NBA and I think that he can continue to rise.
quotes.quote: Right now, I would rank him top 20 in the NBA and I think that he can continue to rise in those rankings. I do think that he is an all-NBA type player and that is going to come. The dude is 19 years old. He is extremely talented. Basically, the first games up until the last two, he has been unbelievable. He has expanded his game.

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Chandler Parsons critiques Cooper Flagg's efficiency and impact when not scoring
quotes.excerpt: My only problem with Cooper Flagg is when the ball is not going to the basket.
quotes.quote: My only problem with Cooper Flagg is when the ball is not going to the basket and he is inefficient, you can see it weighs on him. He has to find ways to impact the game in other ways when he is four for 30 from the field in his last two games at a certain point of the game. He has to find ways to impact the game and winning in other ways.

quotes.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
quotes.summary_phrase: DeMarcus Cousins defends Cooper Flagg against unfair expectations for a 19-year-old
quotes.excerpt: I think that is completely unfair, man. We are talking about a kid that cannot even buy a drink.
quotes.quote: I think that is completely unfair, man. We are talking about a kid that cannot even buy a drink yet. Give the guy some time. You are comparing a 19-year-old kid to 30-year-old guys in their prime. He is still learning. He is still learning how to be a winner. He is still learning how to be a superstar. He is still learning how to impact the game on nights he is having bad nights. That is a process that everybody that came through this league had to go through.

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Chandler Parsons discusses whether the Mavericks should keep or trade Kyrie Irving
quotes.excerpt: If I am Dallas, I want Kyrie Irving in Dallas.
quotes.quote: If I am Cooper Flagg, I want Kyrie Irving in Dallas. I want someone to kind of take some of that pressure off. I want someone to handle the ball to not just allow double team after double team every time I get in the paint because you have one of the best scoring guards of all time on the floor at the same time as you. I personally, I think Cooper would want that and I think Kyrie Irving helps him win basketball games and keeps them more relevant and has them a better chance to win at the end of the day.

quotes.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
quotes.summary_phrase: DeMarcus Cousins is undecided on whether the Mavericks should trade Kyrie Irving
quotes.excerpt: I am in the middle of the road because we are talking about a young budding superstar.
quotes.quote: I am in the middle of the road because we are talking about a young budding superstar in a Cooper Flagg. I think it is beneficial for him to have somebody like a Kyrie Irving around where he can get some game from. He can understand the NBA champion and all of those things. On the flip side of that coin, I would like to see Kyrie Irving go somewhere at this stage in his career where he is around veterans, where he is around a real group that is going to give him an opportunity to get back to the top of the mountain like he has been before. So I am in the middle of the road with what the Mavs could do with Kyrie Irving.

quotes.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
quotes.summary_phrase: DeMarcus Cousins emphasizes the importance of learning from veteran players
quotes.excerpt: You have all these up-and-coming stars that are learning how to be a star from world players.
quotes.quote: You have all these up-and-coming stars that are learning how to be a star from world players. I think about a situation like Darius Garland. He is a superstar in the making, but who exactly is he learning from to be a superstar, how to carry himself, how to lead a group? All of the responsibilities that come with being a superstar, who is he learning from? So when you think about it like that, Cooper Flagg is in a great situation learning from a guy like Kyrie Irving.
